tools.name: ascp.intent.create
tools.title: Create spend intent
tools.description: Submit one bounded payment intent through the same policy and approval path as REST. This never signs or broadcasts a payment.

intent.description: The canonical FlowOps PaymentIntent accepted by POST /v1/intents.

tools.name: ascp.intent.get
tools.title: Get spend intent
tools.description: Read the redacted lifecycle state of an intent owned by the authenticated agent or organization.

tools.name: ascp.approval.list
tools.title: List pending approvals
tools.description: List pending approvals for an authenticated human principal. Agent credentials cannot use this tool.

tools.name: ascp.approval.get
tools.title: Get approval
tools.description: Read one organization-scoped approval record. Agent credentials cannot use this tool.

tools.name: ascp.approval.decide
tools.title: Decide approval
tools.description: Approve or reject an exact pending-approval snapshot. The control plane still requires the human role, fresh step-up authentication, request digest, and idempotency key.
